title: Crocins Ameliorate Experimental Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Myocarditis by Targeting the Hpx/Nrf2/HO-1 Pathway.
authors: Yan, Jing; Cai, Qingqing; Li, Yu; Zhang, Yi; Zhao, Ye; Zhang, Fangbo; Zhang, Huamin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏红花素通过Hpx/Nrf2/HO-1通路改善免疫检查点抑制剂相关心肌炎，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) for cancer therapy may induce immune-related adverse events including myocarditis, which occurs infrequently but carries a high mortality rate. Crocins are the active constituents derived from Crocus sativus L. (saffron), and have demonstrated various bioactivities including anti-tumor, anti-inflammation, antioxidation, anti-ischemia, anti-aging, and neuroprotective effects. This study established a subcutaneous xenotransplanted tumor model of human liver cancer in nude mice to better mimic ICI-related myocarditis. Animal experimental results revealed that crocins improved cardiac function, relieved myocardial damage and autoimmune response, and suppressed oxidative stress and inflammatory reaction. Quantitative proteomics and Western blotting verification confirmed that crocins ameliorated experimental ICI-related myocarditis by targeting the Hpx/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway. Molecular docking revealed that the best docking activities were demonstrated by crocin I-HO-1, crocin II-Hpx, and crocin III-Nrf2. These findings shed new light on the development of therapeutic strategies for treating ICI-related myocarditis and provided the fundamental basis for expanding the clinical application of crocins.
abstract_zh: 用于癌症治疗的免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）可能诱发免疫相关不良事件，包括心肌炎，该病症虽不常见但死亡率高。藏红花素（crocins）是从藏红花（Crocus sativus L.）中提取的活性成分，已显示出多种生物活性，包括抗肿瘤、抗炎、抗氧化、抗缺血、抗衰老及神经保护作用。本研究在裸鼠中建立了人肝癌皮下异种移植肿瘤模型，以更好地模拟ICI相关心肌炎。动物实验结果显示，藏红花素改善了心脏功能，减轻了心肌损伤和自身免疫反应，并抑制了氧化应激和炎症反应。定量蛋白质组学和Western blotting验证证实，藏红花素通过靶向Hpx/Nrf2/HO-1通路改善了实验性ICI相关心肌炎。分子对接显示，藏红花素I-HO-1、藏红花素II-Hpx和藏红花素III-Nrf2表现出最佳的对接活性。这些发现为治疗ICI相关心肌炎的治疗策略开发提供了新视角，并为扩大藏红花素的临床应用奠定了基础。
